entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, agent ID 302. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm... I'm just so lost with it.
I'm sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I don't think it's broken or anything. It's just so confusing. I find it really hard to use, and I honestly expected more from it. I even read the user manual, but that didn't help much. Can't you just help me?
I understand it can be frustrating when a new device doesn't feel intuitive. I can certainly look into this for you. To pull up your order, can you tell me when you received the VeloBand?
Let's see... it was a couple of weeks ago. I think it arrived on December 18th.
Okay, thank you. December 18th. Let me just pull up our return policy information for you. One moment please.
Alright, I've confirmed the policy. Since you received it 19 days ago, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now.
Oh, wow! Really? That's a huge relief. I was so worried I was just stuck with it. Thank you so much, Alex!

You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. I am sending an email with a prepaid shipping label to the address on your account now. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. That was much easier than I thought it would be. Thanks again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
